profile.name: Aditya Malviya
profile.tagline: I build data pipelines that hold up in production.
profile.bio: Senior Data Engineer with 4 years and 9 months at Tata Consultancy Services on the Rolls-Royce Digital account. I build Azure lakehouse pipelines with PySpark, SQL/T-SQL, Python, Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Delta Lake, and Unity Catalog. My work spans Bronze-to-Gold data processing, quality checks, governance, and performance tuning. I collaborate with DevOps colleagues on CI/CD releases and have used Docker to standardize backend service deployment.
profile.bioSecondary: I care about the unglamorous parts — the skewed join that quietly costs an hour a night, the cluster that is three sizes too big, the pipeline nobody can redeploy safely. Fixing those is most of the job.

projects.name: Engine History Analysis
highlights: Architected end-to-end ETL/ELT pipelines using Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks and PySpark, building a medallion-architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold) lakehouse with layer-wise data quality validation and dimensional data models for downstream reporting.
Implemented Unity Catalog for centralized data governance, fine-grained access control and lineage tracking across Databricks workspaces.

Diagnosed and resolved severe data skew in high-volume Spark joins using key salting and Adaptive Query Execution (AQE), cutting pipeline runtime by ~73% (52 to 14 minutes) and eliminating recurring executor out-of-memory failures.
Reduced Azure cloud costs by ~40% through resource optimisation, Databricks cluster right-sizing and reusable parameterised ADF workflows.
Collaborated with the DevOps team during builds and releases of ADF and Databricks pipelines; gained working knowledge of Azure DevOps, YAML and Git branching.

projects.name: Assumptions Management
highlights: Delivered production-grade FastAPI backend services with Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and Azure API Management, containerised with Docker to standardise deployment across environments.
Improved application performance by ~30% via Redis caching, optimised backend and database logic, and structured logging.
Ensured code quality and security by resolving SonarQube hotspots and technical debt, with high coverage through Pytest unit testing.
Collaborated within Agile/Scrum teams, managing tasks in Azure DevOps Boards with cross-functional stakeholders.
